name: Serve Board
intro: You will add a pretend volunteer, put two people on next Sunday's board, give the Nursery a background-check requirement, then reload, go offline and print.

steps.do: On the welcome card at the bottom, tap “skip the tour” (small words, bottom-right).
steps.see: The card changes to “How do you want to start?” with two big buttons.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. A small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” — tap “OK”.
steps.see: The card closes. You see the board: four Sundays, each listing Greeters, Nursery, Kids' check-in, Coffee & donuts, Tech booth and Ushers, every one with an orange “needs someone” button. A purple “🧪 Test copy” bar is at the bottom.

steps.do: Near the top, tap “👥 My people”.
steps.see: A “👥 My people” box opens saying “Nobody yet — add your first person below.”

steps.do: Tap the green “✚ Add a person”.
steps.see: A blank card appears with boxes for name, phone and email, and a row of job buttons under “Can serve as — tap any that apply:”.

steps.do: Tap the “name” box and type this name.
steps.see: The name is in the box, apostrophe and all.

steps.do: Under “Can serve as”, tap “Greeters”.
steps.see: The “Greeters” button turns green.

steps.do: Tap the ✕ at the top-right of the box.
steps.see: You are back on the board. Everything is saved — there is no Save button.

steps.do: On the first Sunday at the top, tap the orange “needs someone” next to “Greeters”.
steps.see: A box opens titled “Greeters — Sunday, …” (that Sunday's date). Under “Your people who can do this:” there is a “Margaret O’Brien” button.

steps.do: Tap “Margaret O’Brien”.
steps.see: The box changes to “✓ Margaret O’Brien is in”, with a ready-made message starting “Hi Margaret O’Brien — you're on for Greeters…” and a note that there is no phone number for her yet.

steps.do: Tap “📋 Copy the message”.
steps.see: A small box says “Copied — paste it into a text or email.” Tap “OK”.

steps.do: Tap “Done — back to the board”.
steps.see: On the first Sunday, “Greeters” now shows “Margaret O’Brien” instead of orange.

steps.do: On the first Sunday, tap the orange “needs someone” next to “Nursery”. Leave the “or type a name” box empty and tap “Put them in”.
steps.see: The box just closes and Nursery still says “needs someone” — nobody was added.

steps.do: Tap that orange “needs someone” next to “Nursery” again. Type this name in the “or type a name” box and tap “Put them in”.
steps.see: “✓ Pastor Dan is in” appears with the message “Hi Pastor Dan — you're on for Nursery…”.

steps.do: Tap “Done — back to the board”.
steps.see: On the first Sunday, “Nursery” shows “Pastor Dan” and “Greeters” still shows “Margaret O’Brien”.

steps.do: Near the top, tap “🧩 Roles & requirements”.
steps.see: A box lists the six jobs, each with a name box and an empty “what this role requires” box under it.

steps.do: In the requirement box under “Nursery”, type this, then tap the ✕ at the top-right.
steps.see: Back on the board, every Sunday shows small words “needs: background check” under “Nursery”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The board comes back with “Margaret O’Brien” and “Pastor Dan” still on the first Sunday. After a moment a card “Keep Serve Board on your Home Screen” pops up at the bottom — tap “Later”.
steps.tip: The Home Screen card is normal on a second visit; “Later” just closes it.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap “＋ Add a Sunday” near the top.
steps.see: A brown bar at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” A fifth Sunday is added at the bottom of the board, all orange.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off (the brown bar goes away). Tap “🖨 Print” near the top.
steps.see: A print preview opens showing the board — the Sundays with Margaret O’Brien and Pastor Dan filled in — without the row of buttons at the top. Tap Cancel.
steps.tip: In the test copy the purple Test copy bar also shows on the preview — that's only the test copy.

steps.do: Tap “↻ Start fresh” near the top. When it asks “Clear the whole board and start fresh? (Roster and roles are kept.)”, tap “Cancel”.
steps.see: Nothing is cleared — Margaret O’Brien and Pastor Dan are still on the first Sunday. That's the end — thank you!
